timing_and_memory.guard_sampling: Maximum of memory.current sampled once per second; memory.peak read only as fallback when sampled peak is zero.

findings.description: Calls check_block but never contextual_check_block. Header insertion and BIP68 do not check BIP34 coinbase height, coinbase finality or witness/weight rules. window_complete can therefore be true with required block checks absent.
findings.source_counterexample: Add a nonempty witness to a pre-SegWit coinbase. txid/merkle/header/created coins remain unchanged, coinbase is not script-checked, but production contextual_check_block rejects UnexpectedWitness. Not executed by Codex.

findings.description: HeaderTree failures only warn and do not enter known_invalid/export/exit decision; missing header context may still exit 0 in strict mode. Window header presence is checked, but tree-derived height is not compared to corpus height; CHAIN section is read and discarded. blocks are not sorted even though predicate loop breaks by height. Require selected-path failure accounting, actual height/ancestry/endpoint binding, and complete-mode enforcement.

Run receipt binds join output but not end-donor file, its validation provenance, converter build/command/output or comparator result. End donor header and canonical file sizes reconcile; claimed full byte equality was not independently rehashed/read by Codex and no separate comparison receipt was found in the reviewed Gate 4 artifacts. Preserve/recover those receipts with the corrected run.

Flat representation removes map cloning, but reserve is capped at 2^26 records and 2^31 script bytes; larger data can reallocate. window_join still constructs the complete canonical output Vec, unlike the streaming converter. Current sampled usage is near the cap. No claim of eliminating future memory pressure or whole-history capacity follows.

source_excerpts.text:
avail=$(awk '/MemAvailable/{print int($2/1024)}' /proc/meminfo)
need=$((MAX_MIB + RESERVE_MIB))
if [ "$avail" -lt "$need" ]; then
    echo "guard_run: REFUSING — MemAvailable=${avail}MiB < required=${need}MiB" \
         "(cap=${MAX_MIB}MiB + reserve=${RESERVE_MIB}MiB)" >&2
    exit 3
fi

# systemd-run in background so we can sample the scope cgroup while it lives.
tmp=$(mktemp)
systemd-run --user --scope \
    -p "MemoryMax=${MAX_MIB}M" -p "MemorySwapMax=0" -p "OOMPolicy=kill" \
    -- "$@" >"$tmp" 2>&1 &
runner=$!

# Wait for the unit name, then poll memory.current → peak.
unit=""
peak=0
slice="/sys/fs/cgroup/user.slice/user-$(id -u).slice/user@$(id -u).service/app.slice"
while kill -0 "$runner" 2>/dev/null; do
    if [ -z "$unit" ]; then
        unit=$(grep -o 'run-[a-zA-Z0-9_-]*\.scope' "$tmp" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    fi
    if [ -n "$unit" ] && [ -f "$slice/$unit/memory.current" ]; then
        cur=$(cat "$slice/$unit/memory.current" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
        [ "$cur" -gt "$peak" ] && peak=$cur
    fi
    sleep 1
done
wait "$runner"; rc=$?

cat "$tmp" >&2
rm -f "$tmp"
# Fallback peak: memory.peak may still exist for a moment after exit.
if [ "$peak" -eq 0 ] && [ -n "$unit" ] && [ -f "$slice/$unit/memory.peak" ]; then
    peak=$(cat "$slice/$unit/memory.peak" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
fi
echo "guard_run: exit=$rc cap=${MAX_MIB}MiB peak=$((peak/1048576))MiB unit=${unit:-n/a}" >&2
exit "$rc"
